answer: Consider a stake-weighted identity bond: each agent must lock collateral to act, and its reputation is a prism that refracts past behavior into one visible trust score. Honest tenure hardens into a pearl of accrued stake, while a sybil swarm has to post fresh bonds for every fake identity. Those bonds bend like a willow under per-address rate limits and slashing, so spawning thousands of fakes costs the attacker real locked capital per account, making mass forgery economically ruinous instead of free.
